tables:
CREATE TABLE assets (
  id            integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  original_name varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  stored_name   varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  created_at    timestamptz DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,   -- was MySQL DATETIME, the schema's only timezone-less column
  CONSTRAINT assets_stored_name_key UNIQUE (stored_name),
  CONSTRAINT unique_original_name UNIQUE (original_name)
);

CREATE TABLE asset_assignment (
  id           integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- holds a workspaces.id; deliberately no foreign key, see column comment
  source       varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  slot_name    varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  asset_id     integer NOT NULL,
  scope        assignment_scope NOT NULL,
  scope_id     varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'global',
  CONSTRAINT unique_assignment UNIQUE (workspace_id, slot_name, scope, scope_id),
  CONSTRAINT asset_assignment_ibfk_1
    FOREIGN KEY (asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
